name: Zedera
summary: The Zedera RO Water Purifier is a premium domestic water purification system designed to provide safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water.

rows: Advanced RO Purification
Multi-stage RO purification effectively removes dissolved salts, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals, chlorine, and harmful contaminants to provide safe drinking water.
Healthy & Mineral-Rich Water
Maintains essential minerals while enhancing the taste, odor, and clarity of drinking water.
Suitable for All Water Sources
Ideal for borewell, municipal corporation, and tanker water with varying TDS levels.
High-Performance RO Membrane
Premium Thin Film Composite (TFC) membrane ensures efficient purification and long-lasting performance.
Food-Grade Storage Tank
Made from high-quality food-grade materials to keep purified water hygienic and safe for everyday use.
Fully Automatic Operation
Automatically starts and stops purification based on the water level, ensuring convenience and energy savings.
Energy Efficient
Low power consumption design delivers reliable performance while minimizing electricity usage.
Elegant & Compact Design
Modern and space-saving cabinet enhances your kitchen while fitting seamlessly into any home interior.
Low Maintenance
Durable filters and premium-quality components reduce maintenance requirements and extend product life.
Ideal Application
Perfect for homes, apartments, offices, and small commercial spaces requiring reliable drinking water purification.
